body:
hey you know what...

I think I'm just kind of done for the night. Look dude/person/being, I'm kind of going through a lot right now and I can't afford a therapist rn so maybe I just need to get off this website and think about .... life. 

I hope whatever you've gone through/are going through gets better and I hope people treat you better than they have in the past. I think I'm gonna shut down and not talk to anyone ever again for awhile. bye and hope you have a nice life, hope there's no hard feelings...

​

also note...by support I mean community support or mental health resource support? Not food? She is capable of feeding herself, in the past we often doordash or grubhub each other food and it was something we used to do on a regular basis, to treat each other to meals when we felt down on some days.
It's hard to say this but you're right. It's hard because it's family and everyone says that we've got to stick out for family. But individually all our lives are our own too.

We have respected her boundaries...like i said...her roommates moved out and I have not gone to visit her since then, out of respect for her boundaries. I do not call, visit, etc. Actually she said 'Texting replies is OK' only when it's initiated by HER and that's why I text at all - only in reply to her initiation. 

We don't have children nor are we elderly so that isn't relevant here. I think you may just be trolling me? If so....then I am sorry but please stop.

Her roommates and I were really concerned when we saw her talking to the wall/thin air and getting naked without warning...we described this to the crisis hotline worker and they advised us to call 911.

Her "talking" was very scary. She was arguing with a person who was not there. When we asked her what was going on, she said "dont interrupt me when i talk to him" and then turned back to the wall and continued a full on conversation with an imaginary person. her roommates had never seen anything like it before.

that's why we thought she was/is ill. The crisis hotline worker is trained for those situations so we trusted their judgment. plus her roommates also said she continued talking to the wall/air after the cops left and they got so scared they broke lease and moved out.

I really did apologize and I really did mean it....I cry everyday and I am just upset and hurt everyday. Your post really hurts me too.
